title: Flow Variables
description: Introduce variables to flow: named dictionaries with one schema, typed relay neurons, cluster inputs/outputs from variables on collapse (auto-wrap crossing edges), schema inferred with picker override.
summary: Introduced flow variables as named, single-schema dictionary relays. Added Variable widget/neuron (core.variable), schema picker APIs (Registry::schema_ids/schema_refs, FlowSession schemasJson), collapse auto-wrap of crossing edges into typed INPUT/OUTPUT contract ports (replacing anonymous __in/__out), explode restores boundary neurons as Variable widgets, React overlay for name+schema editing, catalogue entry, and tests for relay, collapse contract naming, and schema registry accessors. Rebuilt flow WASM.
